o.text:
From Proto-Turkic, probably a derivation of Proto-Turkic *yara- (“be good enough, be sufficient, be successful”), appended with the causative suffix -t.
Cognate with Turkish yaratmak,
Uzbek yaratmoq,
Kyrgyz жаратуу (jaratuu),
Kazakh жарату (jaratuw),
Bashkir яратыу (yaratıw),
Tatar яратучы (yaratuçı, “creator”),
Uyghur ياراتماق (yaratmaq).
Also compare Hungarian gyárt (“to manufacture”), a Turkic borrowing.
By surface analysis, yara- + -t.
From English tramway or from French tramway.
Borrowed from Arabic شَرْقِيّ (šarqiyy). By surface analysis, şərq + -i.
From Arabic نَقْلِيَّات (naqliyyāt). Compare Turkish nakliyat.
